title: Hypercontractivity Under Identical Distribution
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ and $(\Xi,\nu)$ be measure spaces, and let $X:\Omega\to\bbr$ and $Y:\Xi\to\bbr$ be identically distributed with respect to these measures. If $X$ is $(p,q,\rho)$-hypercontractive under $\mu$, then $Y$ is $(p,q,\rho)$-hypercontractive under $\nu$.
hypotheses_covered: $X$ and $Y$ are real-valued functions on measurable spaces
$X$ and $Y$ are identically distributed under $\mu$ and $\nu$
